main_events.title: Settling into University
main_events.narrative: Your Master's semester begins. You can use the first week to prepare for study or get to know the people and routines around campus.

choices.label: Focus on academic preparation
choices.description: Organise your subjects and get ahead on the reading.

choices.label: Attend orientation and meet new people
choices.description: Join the orientation activities and start making connections. Costs $20.

main_events.title: First Assignment
main_events.narrative: The first major assignment is approaching. You are deciding how to balance preparation, collaboration and rest.

choices.label: Start early and organise a study schedule
choices.description: Make a plan and work steadily. It takes a little energy.

choices.label: Work on the assignment with classmates
choices.description: Share ideas and make progress together.

choices.label: Delay the assignment and relax
choices.description: Take a break now and accept the risk of falling behind.

main_events.title: Financial Pressure
main_events.narrative: Your expenses are higher than expected. You need to decide how to respond to the pressure on your budget.

choices.label: Reduce personal spending
choices.description: Keep $40 available by cutting back this week.

choices.label: Accept additional work
choices.description: Earn $100, with less time and energy for study.

choices.label: Ask family for additional financial help
choices.description: Request a one-off $150 contribution.

main_events.title: Group Assignment Conflict
main_events.narrative: A group member is not contributing fairly. How you respond could affect both the work and the group dynamic.

choices.label: Take responsibility and complete more of the work
choices.description: Protect the assignment result at a personal cost.

choices.label: Communicate and divide tasks fairly
choices.description: Talk with the group and agree on clear responsibilities.

choices.label: Avoid confrontation and complete only your own part
choices.description: Keep your workload limited, with some risk to the group outcome.

main_events.title: Campus Social Event
main_events.narrative: A social event is being organised on campus. You can go, stay in to study, or make a shorter appearance.

choices.label: Attend the event
choices.description: Spend time with other students. Costs $40.

choices.label: Stay home and study
choices.description: Make academic progress but miss some social time.

choices.label: Attend briefly and leave early
choices.description: Join for a while without giving up the whole evening. Costs $20.

main_events.title: Family Expectations
main_events.narrative: Family members ask how your studies are going and what you plan to do next. You decide how much time to give the conversation.

choices.label: Spend time talking with family
choices.description: Reconnect and listen, leaving a little less time for study.

choices.label: Focus on study and postpone the conversation
choices.description: Use the time for coursework, while family may feel distant.

choices.label: Explain your situation honestly and discuss expectations
choices.description: Make time to talk openly about what is manageable.

main_events.title: Career Opportunity
main_events.narrative: You find out about a career development opportunity. You can build professional connections, develop a skill, or focus on current coursework.

choices.label: Attend a professional networking event
choices.description: Meet people in your field. Costs $20 and may open an internship pathway.

choices.label: Improve technical or professional skills
choices.description: Spend time on a practical skill and build your career profile.

choices.label: Prioritise current coursework
choices.description: Keep your attention on the semester's academic work.

main_events.title: Academic Challenge
main_events.narrative: A difficult assessment needs extra attention. You can work independently, seek guidance or protect more personal time.

choices.label: Dedicate extra time to study
choices.description: Push hard for progress, at a cost to health and wellbeing.

choices.label: Ask a lecturer or tutor for help
choices.description: Get guidance and a clearer path through the assessment.

choices.label: Accept a lower result and protect personal time
choices.description: Step back from the assessment and recover some energy.

main_events.title: Friendship and Relationships
main_events.narrative: A friend needs support, but your week is already busy. You choose how to respond to them.

choices.label: Spend time supporting your friend
choices.description: Be present for your friend, using time set aside for study.

choices.label: Explain that you are busy and arrange another time
choices.description: Keep the connection while protecting some study time.

choices.label: Ignore the situation
choices.description: Stay focused on your own week, though the friendship may suffer.

main_events.title: Part-time Work Opportunity
main_events.narrative: You receive an opportunity to take on additional work. More shifts could help financially, but would take time and energy.

choices.label: Accept more shifts
choices.description: Earn $150 and gain work experience, with a heavier week.

choices.label: Decline and focus on university
choices.description: Leave more time for study and recovery.

choices.label: Negotiate fewer shifts
choices.description: Earn $70 while keeping a more manageable workload.

main_events.title: Family Responsibility
main_events.narrative: A family situation needs your attention. You consider how to share your time and what support is practical.

choices.label: Prioritise family responsibilities
choices.description: Give family more of your time, leaving less for coursework.

choices.label: Continue studying and provide support remotely
choices.description: Stay on your study plan while keeping in contact.

choices.label: Ask other family members to share the responsibility
choices.description: Work out a shared approach and keep some study time.

main_events.title: End-of-Semester Decisions
main_events.narrative: The semester is almost over. You decide how to use the remaining time before the break.

choices.label: Prepare intensively for final assessments
choices.description: Focus on exams and assignments, with a cost to health and wellbeing.

choices.label: Focus on career planning and future opportunities
choices.description: Look ahead while keeping up with coursework.

choices.label: Take time to recover and reconnect with others
choices.description: End the semester with rest and time with people who matter.

unexpected_events.title: A little extra support
unexpected_events.narrative: Your parents send some extra money to help with the week.

unexpected_events.title: News from home
unexpected_events.narrative: A family member has become ill. You feel concerned and check in with them.

unexpected_events.title: Laptop trouble
unexpected_events.narrative: Your laptop breaks at a difficult time. A repair costs $350.

unexpected_events.title: A week under the weather
unexpected_events.narrative: You become sick and need to pay for medication and take time to recover.

unexpected_events.title: A lost wallet
unexpected_events.narrative: You lose your wallet. The missing cash is a setback.

unexpected_events.title: Rent increase notice
unexpected_events.narrative: Your rent will cost an extra $50 per week from next week onward.

unexpected_events.title: A cancelled work shift
unexpected_events.narrative: A work shift is cancelled at short notice, reducing your expected pay.

unexpected_events.title: An extra work shift
unexpected_events.narrative: A short-notice work shift becomes available. You take it on.

unexpected_events.title: Transport disruption
unexpected_events.narrative: A public transport disruption makes your trip to campus harder this week.

unexpected_events.title: A care package from home
unexpected_events.narrative: A family care package arrives with a thoughtful note.

unexpected_events.title: Unexpected medical expense
unexpected_events.narrative: An unexpected medical expense uses some of your budget.

unexpected_events.title: Support from a friend
unexpected_events.narrative: A close friend notices you have a lot going on and offers support.
